content: next-sanity 13.3.1 is current stable against Sanity Studio v6.9.1. Integration: createClient from next-sanity for GROQ queries. defineLive API for real-time content. VisualEditing component for Draft Mode click-to-edit overlays. Install: npm install next-sanity @sanity/image-url @sanity/visual-editing. Sanity Studio v6 requires Node 22.12+.
